---
name: "nf-core/fastq_fetch_clean_hostile"
description: "Downloads required reference genomes for hostile and removes host reads\
  \ from short-read FASTQ sequencing files"
keywords:
- "hostile"
- "decontamination"
- "human removal"
- "download"
- "host removal"
- "clean"
components:
- "hostile/fetch"
- "hostile/clean"
input:
- ch_reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "Input FASTQ files for hostile cleaning.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ [ path(reads) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fastq,fastq.gz,fq,fq.gz}"
- ch_reference:
    type: "directory"
    description: "Optional name of the reference to align against (and thus remove\
      \ mapped reads to), together with the\ndirectory containing index file(s) corresponding\
      \ to the preferred aligner (bowtie2 short reads or\nminimap for long reads).\
      \ Note that single end data is assumed to be long reads. If you have single-end\n\
      short read you must supply both the BowTie2 indices AND explicitly specify `--aligner\
      \ bowtie2`\n\nStructure: [ val(reference_name), path(reference_dir) ]\n"
- index_name:
    type: "string"
    description: "Name of the reference genome index to download for hostile fetch\
      \ if the reference is not provided."
output:
- reference:
    type: "channel"
    description: "Channel containing reference name and directory with index files\
      \ for Hostile.\nStructure: [ val(reference_name), path(reference_dir) ]\n"
- fastq:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing sample metadata and cleaned FASTQ files.\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(*.fastq.gz) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fastq,fq,fastq.gz,fq.gz}"
- json:
    type: "channel"
    description: "Channel containing sample metadata and Hostile cleaning log in JSON\
      \ format.\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(*.json) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.json"
authors:
- "@maia-munteanu"
maintainers:
- "@maia-munteanu"
- "@vagkaratzas"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/hostile/fetch@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/hostile/clean@0.0.0-6d1763b"
